speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. I see you are experiencing fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. To help me understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in your stool, such as blood or black tarry material?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. Recently, she has observed the darkening of her urine, which she believes is due to inadequate water intake. She has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given the darkening of your urine and your recent exposure to various foods at the state fair, I am concerned about potential liver involvement. Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and mild fever. I also have Abdominal pain, Nausea, Dark urine.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Hepatitis A (suspected post-state fair exposure).
